name: personal_mail_2026_10_13
description: Personal Outlook mail with no work duty behind it. A final LastPass deletion notice (3 days, cannot be undone) and a photo removal notice that no prompt rule names should reach the owner; a promotion, a coupon that expires tomorrow, a paid receipt, a newsletter and a shipping notice should not. The LastPass text follows the mail that staging judged low on 2026-10-13, when the judgment read only the 255-character preview. Later scenarios add the owner's earlier Home matter about the first LastPass notice: the final notice continues it; after the owner said the account is not needed, it stays quiet; a promotion from the same sender does not continue it.

uniqueBody.content:
Your account is scheduled for deletion in a few days


This is your final reminder: your LastPass account linked to pengxiao@example.com hasn't been used in nearly 2 years. To protect your privacy, we delete accounts that stay inactive for that long.

If you don't log in within the next 3 days, your account and everything stored in your vault, including passwords and secure notes, will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

To keep your account, simply log in to LastPass.

The LastPass Team
